name: Inui Global Logistics Co., Ltd.
summary: Inui Global Logistics Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides shipping, warehousing and transportation, and real estate services in Japan, rest of Asia, Oceania, Europe, the Middle East, North America, South America, and internationally. It operates in three segments: Ocean Shipping Business; Warehousing and Transportation Business; and Real Estate Business. The company offers dry bulk services; ship chartering; vessel operating and leasing; and transportation services for various products, such as grain, timber, cement, fertilizer, and other dry bulk cargoes.
